newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual ready for more takeovers.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual ready for more takeovers.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc chairman and chief executive Kerry Killinger said the company has substantially completed its acquisition of American Savings Bank and is ready to consider further acquisitions.
He told a Piper Jaffray investors conference the company was ahead of schedule in integrating American Savings Bank and was in the "glide path" to complete the process by year-end.
Killinger declined comment on reports Washintgon Mutual is involved in exploratory discussions with Great Western Financial Corp, which is the target of a hostile $6.1 billion bid by H.F. Ahmanson
